== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Richard Linton. Daniel Glasco, Norfolk planter, conveyed 100 acres to Richard Linton with the consent of Mary, explicitly his wife. The court endorsement says Daniel personally acknowledged the deed on 3 September 1729, establishing survival to that date.<ref>Princess Anne County, Deeds and Wills Book4 Part1 (1724–1735), manuscript p.207, DGS7645780; [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/3:1:3QS7-99PX-F3DX record].</ref> Inspected original deed endorsement. Registration alone is not used as a life boundary. The identification remains uncertain.
